description: Native gold sold as a mineral specimen: nugget, crystal or wire, on or off matrix. A refined bar, round or coin sold by weight is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.
Uncut quartz specimen, including rock crystal points and clusters, and tumbled or polished quartz, where no separate kind covers the variety.
Uncut purple quartz: geode, point, cluster, tumbled stone, slab or sphere. A faceted or cabochon amethyst is under Cut amethyst in Gemstones & pearls.
Uncut or polished opaque microcrystalline quartz: rough, tumbled stone, slab or sphere.
Opal specimen, matrix piece or uncut nodule. A loose opal cut as a cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold for cutting, is under Cut opal.
Uncut corundum specimen, including ruby and sapphire crystals on or off matrix. Cut stones and cutting rough are under Sapphire and Ruby in Gemstones & pearls.
Magnesium aluminium oxide mineral specimen: octahedral crystals, on or off matrix. Cut stones are under Cut spinel.
Barium sulfate mineral specimen: bladed crystals, clusters and roses.
Uncut tourmaline specimen: crystals and clusters, on or off matrix. Cut stones and facet-grade rough sold by weight are under Cut tourmaline.
Uncut garnet-group specimen: crystals on or off matrix, and tumbled stones. Cut stones and cutting rough are under Cut garnet.
Uncut beryl specimen (aquamarine, morganite, heliodor, emerald crystals), on or off matrix. Cut stones are in Gemstones & pearls.
Uncut topaz crystal or specimen, on or off matrix. A faceted stone or cutting rough is under Cut topaz.
Uncut or polished lapis lazuli (a rock rich in lazurite), sold as a specimen. A cabochon is in Gemstones & pearls.
Serpentine-group mineral or serpentinite specimen, rough, tumbled or polished.

also_called: microcline · amazonite · labradorite · orthoclase · moonstone · sunstone
description: Uncut feldspar-group specimen, rough or polished: microcline, amazonite, labradorite, orthoclase, moonstone and sunstone. Cut stones are in Gemstones & pearls.
Kit of different labelled specimens (rocks, and minerals or fossils) sold as one standard set, usually for teaching. A mixed set not sold as a teaching kit goes with its most valuable item.
Fossil ammonoid shell, whole, split, polished or on matrix, including unworked stones kept for a religious tradition.
Gem-quality iridescent ammonite shell material, rough or cut.
Fossil coral, solitary or colonial, rough, polished or on matrix. A dead modern coral skeleton is under Coral skeleton.
Fossil insect or other land arthropod preserved in rock. An insect in amber or copal is under Amber or Copal.
Fossil coiled nautiloid shell, whole, split or polished. Straight nautiloids such as Orthoceras are under Belemnite.
Fossil tooth, bone or claw of a dinosaur.
Fossil tooth, bone or other part of a mammal, such as mammoth, cave bear or whale.
Fossil leaf, fern, frond, seed or cone, as an impression, compression or nodule. Petrified wood is separate.
Fossilised tree resin, raw, polished or cut, with or without insects or other inclusions.
Stony meteorite without chondrules that is not lunar, Martian or HED: aubrites, angrites, ureilites and primitive achondrites.
Loose diamond of natural fancy colour, graded on the separate coloured-diamond scale.
Loose cut red corundum, or ruby cutting rough.
Loose cut spinel, or spinel cutting rough.
Loose faceted or cabochon amethyst, or amethyst cutting rough. Uncut amethyst specimens are under Amethyst in Minerals & crystals.
Loose faceted or cabochon garnet of any species, or garnet cutting rough. Uncut specimens are under Garnet in Minerals & crystals.
Loose faceted or cabochon tourmaline, or facet-grade tourmaline rough sold by weight. Uncut specimens are under Tourmaline in Minerals & crystals.
Loose opal cut as a cabochon or faceted, or opal rough sold for cutting. Opal specimens and uncut nodules are under Opal in Minerals & crystals.
Dead, dried skeleton of a coral. Living coral is not sold here; fossil coral is under Fossil coral.
Dried, emptied shell (test) of a sea urchin.
Dried whole starfish (sea star) kept as a specimen. A fossil starfish is under Echinoderm fossil; craft assortments are in Craft & Art Supplies.
Shell of a living-species brachiopod (lamp shell) kept as a specimen. Fossil brachiopods are under Fossil brachiopod.
Real tusk or tusk section kept as a specimen. Ivory rules apply.
Blown or emptied eggshell, or a dried nest, kept as a specimen. An egg for hatching is not sold here.
Real antler or horn kept as a specimen. An antler chew for dogs is in Animal Equipment.
Cleaned real skull of a bony fish kept as a specimen. A dried jaw or tooth set is under Fish jaw or teeth set.
Real animal skeleton, cleaned and articulated on a stand or in a case.
Real modern animal claw, talon or tooth kept as a specimen. Fossil teeth are under Fossils & amber.
Feather kept and labelled as a specimen. Craft feathers are in Craft & Art Supplies.
Pressed, dried plant mounted on a sheet as a specimen. Dried flowers for decor are in Decor.
Wet specimen of an animal or other organism kept in preserving fluid in a jar.
Box made to hold one specimen, such as a thumbnail box. A box holding several is in Furniture & Storage.
Glazed floating frame or case made to hold and display one specimen. One holding several, such as a Riker tray, is in Furniture & Storage.
